note: Campground and cabins in the pines on M-37 just south of Baldwin, 15 wooded acres bordering the Manistee National Forest, with ride-out access to local ORV/ATV trails; back-in RV sites to 28-40 ft, tent, rustic and group sites, seven cabins and a rental RV. Minutes from the Pere Marquette, Pine and Baldwin rivers. Formerly ivanscanoe.com. Google 4.7 over 304 reviews. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms RV sites with 30-amp electric and water (no sewer; dump station), pull-thru and back-in, heated bathhouse, WiFi, camp store; per-person pricing $16/guest/night + $10 electric + $10 water (recorded $42-52 for 2 adults stands); online booking via ResNexus. Phone (231) 745-9345 matches. Note trimmed of hookup/booking/rate/RV Life text.
flags: Mostly-seasonal check: the operator mentions 'seasonal options' among its 60-site property but sells nightly RV sites online (ResNexus) with posted per-night rates; it reads as an ordinary transient campground, not seasonal in character.

Price gate: base $42 (2 adults, electric only) or $52 with water; the water-and-electric site most RVs would book is $52, just over US$50, while the electric-only rate is under it. No gateway within 40 km (Grand Rapids 103 km); the family has not stayed here.
